messages.subject: barplot in proportion
parts:
Hi,


DATA = data.frame(sex = c("M", "W"), freq = c(12, 35))
p =qplot( sexe, data= DATA, geom="bar", weight=freq )


This plots absolute values of freq according to levels of sex.

Is there a way in ggplot2 to plot freq in percentage of the total,
which would give the same visual aspect except for y scale changed to
% ?

Optionaly is there a way to put the % value of each level just on top
of the bar ?


Regards
PB

messages.author: b756a7daa2c2aa6d
messages.subject: Re: barplot in proportion
parts:
Hi pb,

Here's one way:

qplot( sex, ..density.., data = DATA, geom="bar", weight=freq , group = 1)

Here's another way:

DATA <- transform(DATA, freq / sum(freq)
# or if in your real problem you have grouping variables
DATA <- ddply(DATA, c("age", "race"), transform, perc = freq / sum(freq))

qplot( sex, data = DATA, geom="bar", weight=perc)


Hadley
